verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents a REST-style 'Airbyte API' for programmatic control (airbyte-docs-3, airbyte-docs-18, airbyte-docs-46), but there is no evidence of an actual downloadable machine-readable spec (OpenAPI/Swagger) accompanying it — the direct probe for openapi.json/swagger.json paths returned all 404s (airbyte-probe-2). Without a confirmed spec file or documented spec download link, the capability is not evidenced.
